channel.description: Latest articles from Santa Monica Daily Press (smdp.com)

item.title: Santa Monica rents plunge 7.5% as coastal market cools faster than nation
item.description: Santa Monica rents fell 7.5% annually to $2,318 median in March 2026, marking the steepest decline in LA metro area as coastal market cools.

item.title: Andrew Lloyd Webber's Requiem to Close Music at Westwood Season
item.description: Music at Westwood presents Andrew Lloyd Webber's Requiem April 24 at 8pm at Westwood Presbyterian Church. Free concert features Grammy-winning work.

item.title: California Bill Would Require Advance Notice, Reasons for Insurance Nonrenewals
item.description: California Senator Ben Allen's SB 1301 would require property insurers to give 6 months notice and explain reasons before dropping coverage.

item.title: Santa Monica College Earns Black-Serving Institution Designation
item.description: Santa Monica College is one of 31 California institutions designated as Black-Serving Institutions, recognizing strong support for Black students.

item.title: Santa Monica Council Sends Back Boulevard Safety Plan, Demands Stronger Protections
item.description: Santa Monica City Council unanimously rejected a safety plan for Santa Monica Boulevard, demanding stronger pedestrian protections after 435 injury crashes in 10 years.

item.title: Hope for the Unhoused
item.description: Patricia Kusaba, SMC Homeless Service Work certificate graduate, creates Hope Toolkit website after experiencing housing instability during COVID-19.

item.title: Scouts learn rocket science at Museum of Flying
item.description: Palisades Troop 223 scouts met with retired rocket scientist Adrienne Russo at Santa Monica's Museum of Flying on Feb. 28 for Space Exploration merit badge work.

item.title: Santa Monica Airport: Why JSX Approvals Require CEQA Review
item.description: JSX began scheduled passenger flights from Santa Monica Airport without required California Environmental Quality Act review, according to local advocates.

item.title: Police Seek Public's Help Identifying Sexual Battery Suspect
item.description: Santa Monica Police are asking for public help identifying a Hispanic male, 20-30 years old, connected to a sexual battery investigation.
